items.title: ‘Like a bolt from the blue’: Israel’s president shocked by Trump announcing end of aid
items.brief: Israeli President Isaac Herzog said it was “like a bolt from the blue” when President Donald Trump announced he would end US aid to Israel on Tuesday, the day of the midterm elections.

items.title: Wisconsin infant is US’ third measles-related death this week
items.brief: An infant in Wisconsin has died in connection with an large, ongoing measles outbreak, the state health department said Thursday.

items.title: Newsom commutes sentences of all California death row prisoners
items.brief: California Gov. Gavin Newsom announced Thursday he is commuting every death sentence in his state to a sentence of life in prison without parole.

items.title: ‘Catastrophic’ flooding sets off dozens of rescues, inundates homes and businesses in North Georgia and southern Tennessee
items.brief: Historic flooding inundated homes and businesses in North Georgia and southern Tennessee, leading to dozens of water rescues and evacuations.

items.title: Postal worker accused of shooting 2 co-workers at Des Moines post office, police say
items.brief: A US Postal Service employee is in custody on suspicion of shooting two of her co-workers at a large post office near downtown Des Moines, Iowa, on Thursday morning, police said.

items.title: Winning ticket drawn in New Jersey for $847 million Powerball jackpot
items.brief: A single Powerball ticket in New Jersey has won an estimated $847 million after matching all six numbers in Wednesday’s drawing, the company said Thursday.
